$comment: Hand decisions for the ownership registry (apps/api/scripts/db-ownership.mjs). Each entry overrides the heuristic class (A-E) and/or domain and MUST say why. Remove an entry when its table is dropped (the gate fails on a stale one).

process_heartbeats.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 B (Constitution 11 §154, §49): one row per API / worker process boot (build labels, memory / CPU, the registry digest the System Operations dashboards read) — platform telemetry like system_health_snapshots

device_biometric_credentials.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 13 D (Constitution 6 §37-39): a person's Face ID device credential (hashed secret bound to a device id), owned by the user like sessions / refresh_tokens / auth_devices; tenant_id only records the salon of the enrolling session (NULL for a cross-salon customer identity); redeemed by credential id before any tenant context exists

realtime_stream_tickets.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 13 (Constitution 6 §28-32): single-use 60 s tickets bound to a person's SESSION (like sessions / refresh_tokens) that open a realtime stream from a native app; redeemed by hash before any tenant context exists

api_operations.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 12: the async operation records (exports today) - the job-queue side of the API, beside jobs; tenant_id NULL = a platform (Super Admin) operation

community_appeals.reason: the owners' safety community (Constitution 1 §3 E example 'approved safety-community posts'): one post is read by every salon; visibility is decided by moderation status, not by tenant_id

community_risk_fingerprints.reason: platform moderation signal (hashed fingerprints) used by Super Admin only; never shown to a salon

gift_card_settlement_batches.reason: cross-salon gift card clearing: a batch nets redemptions between issuing and redeeming tenants (program-level, see gift_card_clearing_entries)

nail_showcase_comments.reason: public nail showcase: a comment/reaction on a published post is visible across salons; the post's own visibility rules apply

nail_showcase_photos.reason: public nail showcase: published rows are cross-salon by design; tenant_id (nullable) records the originating salon, not the audience

nail_showcase_posts.reason: public nail showcase: published rows are cross-salon by design; tenant_id (nullable) records the originating salon, not the audience

nail_showcase_reactions.reason: public nail showcase: a comment/reaction on a published post is visible across salons; the post's own visibility rules apply

reviews.reason: a salon's review of its own visit: tenant-owned; global_tech_profile_id only attributes it to the technician's platform profile

tenants.reason: the tenant registry itself: platform-global, keyed by id (no tenant_id by definition)

mobile_app_versions.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 13 B (Constitution 6 §55-57): the store apps' version policy (minimum / recommended / latest per app and native platform) - the same binaries serve every salon, so it is platform-global and Super Admin-owned

mobile_app_installs_seen.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 13 B (Constitution 6 §150): hashed install id -> app version for the version distribution; no tenant, no user, no raw device id

telemetry_log_events.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 A (Constitution 11 §291-292): the platform's own redacted log store - lines from every salon's requests and from platform work, read only by Super Admin request search (super_admin.telemetry.*); tenant_id is a NULLable label for filtering, never a scope; written only by the telemetry sink through the worker pool; 14-day retention

telemetry_spans.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 A: the trace half of the same store (spans of sampled traces), same readers, same writer, same window

oncall_contacts.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 C (Constitution 11 §262-264): the platform on-call chain (who is paged, in what order, quiet hours) - platform configuration, edited only by Super Admin with step-up

alert_escalations.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 C (§264-265): each step of a PLATFORM alert's escalation and its acknowledgement (screen or signed single-use link); platform alerts only (tenant_id IS NULL)

slo_validations.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 C (§80): the platform SLO verdicts computed from platform_request_metrics_minute - one row per SLO, no tenant data

synthetic_monitoring_settings.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 C (§92-95): single-row platform setting; test_tenant_id NAMES the one salon Kevin designates for the kiosk probe - a reference, not a scope (the row belongs to the platform)

synthetic_probe_results.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 C: latest result per synthetic probe (rows = probes); platform health, no tenant data

observability_signal_state.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 C (D8): last-seen platform signal values (break-glass mode) so a toggle opens one security incident fleet-wide

code_lookup_attempts.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 D (Constitution 12): the lookup-by-code limiter's attempt ledger (gift-card / coupon / deal code guesses) - one weighted row per attempt, keyed by hashed caller / IP and the salon, read only by the limiter; minutes-long window, swept by the central retention executor

turn_unit_rules.reason: Fair Turn Engine (wave 2, migration 601): versioned turn-unit weights per service / category / duration — read and written only by the workforce turn-queue module (turn-queue.service saveRule / retireRule, turn-ledger loadTurnRules)
